g: A letter of the Anglo-Saxon runic alphabet, ᚣ, representing the vowel sounds /y/ and /yː/ in Old English.
(physics) The state of a nucleus with minimum energy, but excluding the yrast. The second-least excited state for a given angular momentum.
(physics) The state of a nucleus with minimum energy (i.e. when least excited) for a given angular momentum.
(physics) A local minimum on the graph of yrast for a certain spin.
(rare) A reciprocal unit of measurement for electrical inductance.
